title: Nonempty opens have finite complements in irreducible Noetherian curves
statement: Let $X$ be an irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components] quasi-sober Noetherian Kolmogorov topological space with topological Krull dimension at most one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. The complement of any nonempty open subset of $X$ is finite.

proof.text: The complement is closed and Noetherian, hence has a finite cover by irreducible closed subsets, by the topological finite-component theorem underlying [lem-sc-noetherian-closed-subset-finite-components]. Each has a generic point by quasi-sobriety. The generic point lies outside the nonempty open, so [lem-sc-dim-one-point-outside-open-closed] makes its singleton closed. Each subset is therefore that singleton, and their finite union is finite. This is the existing complete Lean proof of IsOpen.finite_compl_of_topologicalKrullDim_le_one.
